Run the project with its pinned HappyView; a saved file is live on the next request.

A compiled module is rebuilt when a file under its own directory changes. A path dependency outside
that directory, or a workspace's Cargo.lock above it, is not watched: after changing one, save a
file in the module to rebuild it.

Usage: hpy happyview dev [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Print the result as JSON on stdout

      --locked
          Fail rather than update happyview.lock when it no longer matches happyview.toml

      --network <NETWORK>
          Which atproto network to run against

          Possible values:
          - real:  The real atproto network; writes reach your real PDS
          - local: A private network on this computer (Atmosphere in a Box; needs Docker and Deno
            2.8)
          
          [default: real]

      --no-input
          Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes. Implied
          without a terminal

  -C <DIR>
          Run as if started in DIR

      --reset
          Discard the local network's accounts, records and database, then start fresh

      --subnet <CIDR>
          The private IPv4 network the local network is created on, when the one derived from the
          project's path is taken. Kept until another is given

  -y, --yes
          Do not ask for confirmation

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
